info.title: The Harness Bible API
info.description: Phase 1 endpoints (feature-specs/09 § 6.2). Every response carries `traceparent`; errors are `{ code, message, detail?, traceId }`; rate-limited endpoints carry `RateLimit-Limit`, `RateLimit-Remaining`, `RateLimit-Reset`.

get.summary: The pinned release
Every chapter of the pinned release with its verification state
A chapter: header, outline and its first section
A section with its figures, source rows and code panes
The derive.py line behind a derived figure
A chapter's improvement history: its versions newest first, each merged change with its evidence and the people who made it, the credit list, what changed by layer, and the chain checked now
Download a chapter's records — its merged suggestions' — as signed JSONL, for anyone signed in; the export is recorded

An audit pack you asked for: its state, count and head hash, and once ready a signed URL that serves the file for 24 hours
Search sections, lab READMEs and registry rows
The three reading paths with the caller's progress

Send a finding of one's own research to Improve as a researcher's proposal; Improve opens its sources, grades them, and a curator decides

get.summary: The rubric in force: tiers, adjustments, thresholds, the chips' tiers, the worked examples and the changelog
A published rubric by its version

post.summary: Start a draft suggestion on a section, a figure or a source row of the pinned release: its anchor resolved, its class computed, its id allocated

get.summary: A suggestion as its owner or a curator of one of its parts reads it: anchor, proposal, evidence, score, and the sensors and adjudication once they exist

patch.summary: Write the proposal and the rationale into a draft of one's own; the class and the thresholds come back recomputed. Idempotent by content

delete.summary: Delete a draft of one's own, with everything it has; a suggestion past draft is a record and stays

post.summary: Submit a draft of one's own: consent, the four intake sensors, the workflow started, then the row marked submitted; a suggestion open for revision is signalled instead
Withdraw a suggestion of one's own where its workflow waits for a person: the request written on the row, the workflow told, and its retracted record awaited; 202 while it records

get.summary: A suggestion's records with their hashes and the chain checked now, for its owner or a curator of one of its parts; once merged, for anyone
Download a suggestion's records as signed JSONL, for its owner or a curator of one of its parts; the export is recorded

302.description: Redirect; cookies travel as Set-Cookie headers.

get.summary: What waits for the caller's parts of the book, in the curator queue's groups, each item with its deadline; and what the caller decided today

post.summary: A curator decides a suggestion in the queue of one of their parts: accept, keep the request for more, or decline, with a coded reason and a note where the decision overrides the adjudicator; or merges one whose check passed; or reverts a merged one, with a note

The reader who asked puts their name to a research proposal that came from their question, with consent to keep it for provenance; while the proposal waits for a curator or is being merged, until the curator's merge is taken

delete.summary: The reader takes their name off a research proposal, until the curator's merge is taken; the ledger keeps the endorsement and its withdrawal

post.summary: A curator of the part has an accepted suggestion's merge prepare its branch and check it again — after a commit of their own on the branch, or once what stopped it is set right — or starts its merge where none runs

get.summary: The adjudicator's calibration against the curators by quarter: the override rate per criterion, κ and adjudication precision, each with its counts, and the rubric reviews the rates opened

Add an evidence item to a draft suggestion; it is fetched and graded by a workflow
